items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: We used to play for him at the economy hall, you know.

ctx.x: I know. Manuel Mineta teaches all of those same kind of things. Manuel Mineta? He teaches time like that, too, and all that.

I'm talking about Manuel. That is my brother's best friend, him and Freddie. He used to play violin. When Freddie was playing cornet, he used to be, and him and Freddie, every time you see Freddie, you see him. They used to go at this fellow, what they call Henry Morton. Henry Morton's place, they used to go up on Second and Magazine. Well, that was a fine place. Oh, it was a fine place. I don't know if you heard talk about this fellow here, what they call him again, this here fellow, I can't forget it, I can't,…
